question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Meta guided Q3 2026 revenue to $61-64B (FX ~1% headwind); consensus ~$63.3B, BofA $63.8B. Meta has habitually landed at or above the top of its guide: Q2'26 $60.8B vs $58-61B guide (+1% vs consensus), Q1'26 $56.3B vs $53.5-56.5B, Q4'25 $59.9B vs $56-59B, Q3'25 $51.2B vs $47.5-50.5B. Applying a typical 1-3% consensus beat gives a median ~$64.2B. Downside: ad softness or FX moves; legal accrual hits expenses not revenue. No prediction market found (harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi/bookmakers not checked separately). Escape outside 61-67B judged negligible.

The last two quarters landed just below the top of the guide, so I center slightly below 64B. (2) Late-Q3 dollar strength (Run 3 only): factual but not verifiable without web access, so I treat it as a small downside skew. (3) Escape probability: all runs agree it is negligible and I concur. I carry forward Run 3's dispersion basis, slightly tightened. No market found by any run (Kalshi page not priced or returned 429; none on Polymarket or Manifold).
